title: Threshold representation of evaluation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let a sparse Fourier hypothesis consist of a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ with a rational coefficient for each subset. For every sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, its evaluation is $1$ when the real-valued Fourier sum at $x$ is nonnegative and $-1$ otherwise.
